How is मोड़ दर used in maritime?

Definition

The speed at which a vessel changes its heading, typically measured in degrees per minute and displayed on the bridge instrument panel.

Operational example

Monitor rate of turn during manoeuvre. Excessive rate may result in loss of control or overshoot. Adjust rudder and engine orders as required and report to bridge.

Localized term
